newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's emperor to visit Brazil, Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Japan's emperor to visit Brazil, Argentina.

text.p: Japan's Emperor Akihito and Empress Michiko will visit Brazil and Argentina for two weeks from May 30, chief government spokesman Seiroku Kajiyama said on Tuesday.
During their stay, the royal couple will meet leaders of the two countries as well as Japanese immigrants and their descendants.
They will also make stopovers in Luxembourg and the United States during the trip.
The emperor and empress visited Brazil and Argentina in 1967 as crown prince and princess, but it will be the first visit to the two countries by a reigning emperor and empress.
The trip had been delayed due to the hostage crisis in Peru. Marxist rebels who stormed the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima on December 17 are still holding 72 hostages.
The cabinet formally approved the imperial couple's official visit to the two countries on Tuesday morning.
